step-1.text: Lay one side flat, the stepped edge facing you. Tap the wood dowels into the holes for the two steps and the back rail.

count-1.text: This step uses 1 side and 5 wood dowels.

step-2.text: Press both steps and the back rail onto the dowels. Wipe off any glue that squeezes out, if you used some.

count-2.text: This step uses 2 steps and 1 back rail.

step-3.text: Put the second side on top and drive the screws through it into the steps and the rail. Then flip it and tighten the first side too.

count-3.text: This step uses 1 side and 6 screws.

step-4.text: Stand it on a flat floor and press on each corner of the top step. Retighten after the first week, wood settles.

count-4.text: Nothing new this step. Just you and the frame.

done.text: Step stool done. Kitchen top shelves just got a lot closer.
